newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines determined to defend peso-C. Bank.
newsitem.headline: Philippines determined to defend peso-C. Bank.

text.p: The Philippines is determined to defend its peso from speculative attack but the latest spillover from the effective devaluation of the Thai baht on Wednesday should die down, Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson told Reuters.
"You should expect some intial spillover effect. I am very confident this will settle down," he said in a telephone interview.
"We are determined to defend out currency," Singson said.

"We have shown our determination in the past to defend the currency from speculative attacks. This is a speculative attack on the currency resulting from what happened in Thailand...it is not affecting the fundamentals. The fundamentals are still good."
The Central Bank sold dollars actively and raised interest rates this morning after Thailand announced it was introducing a managed baht float.
"It is not a Philippine problem...it is just a spillover effect," Singson said.
He would not say whether the Bank would introduce further measures to protect the peso.
"We will see how the market will react (to higher interest rates)...it is too premature to say," he added.
